name: Doctor of Theology in Church History
admission: Open to male students only; minimum 60 hour Master's degree in a field of theological study which includes 6 hours of Hebrew and 6 hours of Greek; applicants without the original languages must first complete the M.Div. language courses (BS500; BS501) as part of the degree program; M.Div or Th.M preferred for admission.
requirements: All written assignments (with the exception of the dissertation) should follow current MLA formatting.
All numbered assignments (lecture outlines/notes, summaries, chapter summaries, papers, etc.) must be submitted to your mentor for grading.

Dissertation topics must first be approved by the seminary administration. The dissertation topic must be directly related to church history. Students must use the Request for Approval of Dissertation Topic Form when submitting their topic for approval. The completed form should be emailed to info@logcollege.net. Students should not begin dissertation work until the seminary administration has first approved the topic.
FORMATTING: Current Turabian
Your dissertation should be no less than 150 pages, 1 inch margins (1.5 inch left margin), twelve-point type, Times New Roman font, double spaced.
Your dissertation should be free of grammatical and syntax errors and should represent the caliber of work you have completed during your Doctoral Program.

Your dissertation should be consecutively numbered, with a table of contents and appendices if necessary. Your dissertation should be divided into relevant chapters with sub-section headings within each chapter. You will need to also include a list of tables, figures and illustrations that are included.
Your dissertation must include a submission page and full bibliography.
Your dissertation must be submitted to LCS administration by your mentor (after grading) for final review and approval before you will be considered for graduation.
